feedback: Your essay presents a clear and sensible position regarding cellphone use in classrooms. You have identified the key tension between the benefits of technology and the need for classroom discipline. To improve your writing, try to develop your arguments further by explaining the 'why' behind your points rather than just listing them. For example, instead of just mentioning that phones can be a distraction, explore how this impacts the quality of learning. Additionally, try to vary your sentence structure to make your writing more engaging. You have a good grasp of the topic, but adding more specific, well-explained examples will help you move into a higher scoring band. Keep working on expanding your vocabulary to express your ideas with more precision.
